jobDescription:
Responsibilities Set & Manage Compliance Program for Information & Cyber Security Requirements (e.g. regulatory, ISO27001 standards, PCI DSS) Develop a set of security standards, technical solutions, strategies, ISO requirements and best practices for the organization, and recommend security enhancements to management as needed. Experience driving and governing audits and practice standardization (PCIDSS, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, etc) across multiple teams. Hands on experience with audits, Info Sec compliances, Vulnerability assessments. Experience with technologies and processes such as networks, encryption, vulnerability management, identity and access management, endpoint management, risk management, and cloud services. Good to have Familiarity and understanding of OWASP. Basic knowledge of software development lifecycles and methodologies Experience presenting and influencing top-line management and executives on the importance of Information Security. Expert problem solver, using proven methods to solve difficult issues effectively Proven conflict management skills and remains composed under pressure Good understanding of infrastructure, including web & cloud technologies and network architecture. jobDescription:
Responsibilities Responsible for supporting & execution of the association for Digital Payments / Products and Solutions with clients with engagement strategy and priorities. Develop relationship with assigned account across all functions in the account & be the primary point of contact on behalf of the organisation. Undertake Presentations / product demos / Proposals and successfully negotiate closure in line with strategic priorities, revenue and profitability targets by understanding clients existing business model. Serve as the expert and advocate for the payments landscape to identify and understand the opportunities, challenges and potential priorities to establish mutually beneficial partnerships. Align and manage internal stakeholders within products and technology to ensure timely deliverables, maintain regular visibility of project's progress and impact post go-live. Liaise with Internal & External Stakeholders to solve issues, communicate needs and create synergy.
